description: Ransomware qui chiffre les fichiers .docx et .pdf en utilisant les API cryptographiques Windows et affiche une note de rançon
regle_yara:
rule Ransomware_Documents {
    meta:
        description = "Ransomware ciblant documents Office et PDF"
        author = "Dataset_YARA"
        date = "2026"
    strings:
        $crypt1 = "CryptEncrypt"
        $crypt2 = "CryptGenKey"
        $ext1 = ".docx" nocase
        $ext2 = ".pdf" nocase
        $ext3 = ".xlsx" nocase
        $ransom1 = "YOUR_FILES_ARE_ENCRYPTED" nocase
        $ransom2 = "HOW_TO_DECRYPT" nocase
        $hex1 = { 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? FF 15 ?? ?? ?? ?? 85 C0 }
    condition:
        (1 of ($crypt*)) and (1 of ($ext*)) and (1 of ($ransom*))
}

description: Ransomware demandant un paiement Bitcoin avec adresse de wallet et timer de pression
regle_yara:
rule Ransomware_Bitcoin {
    meta:
        description = "Ransomware avec demande de rançon Bitcoin"
        author = "Dataset_YARA"
        date = "2026"
    strings:
        $btc1 = "bitcoin" nocase
        $btc2 = "BTC" fullword
        $wallet = /[13][a-km-zA-HJ-NP-Z1-9]{25,34}/
        $timer = "hours remaining" nocase
        $pay = "send payment" nocase
        $decrypt = "after payment" nocase
    condition:
        ($btc1 or $btc2) and $wallet and (1 of ($timer, $pay, $decrypt))
}

}
